rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Each month of use for each affected unit may be a separate violation. Tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief and civil penalties.
rules.key_value: Ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation (per unit per month)
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.penalty: Tenant damages, injunctive relief, and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; each month of use for each affected unit may be a separate violation

rules.title: San Diego prohibition on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Prohibits landlords' use of algorithmic rent-setting devices similar to San Francisco's ban. Tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief and penalties; each month and affected rental property may be a separate violation.
rules.key_value: Ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices; penalties up to $1,000 per violation
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.penalty: Tenant damages, injunctive relief and penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each month and affected rental property may be a separate violation

rules.title: Berkeley prohibition on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Prohibits landlords' use of coordinated pricing algorithms to set rents; violations recur per unit per month; private remedies available.
rules.key_value: Ban on coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies

rules.title: Santa Ana ban on anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing. Tenants may bring private claims for up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.key_value: Ban on automated rent price-fixing; up to $1,000 per violation per month
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.penalty: Private tenant claims; up to $1,000 per violation and per month

rules.title: Jersey City prohibition on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Prohibits a landlord's use of algorithmic rent coordination services; enforceable through both public and private enforcement.
rules.key_value: Ban on algorithmic rent coordination services; fines up to $2,000 per day
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.penalty: Fines up to $2,000 per day; public and private enforcement

rules.title: Hoboken prohibition on rent-coordinating software and algorithms
rules.requirement: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.key_value: Ban on software/algorithms/data-sharing platforms that coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms or occupancy
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
